name: zendesk-connector
description: Use Zendesk Support tickets from Codex through a local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Search, inspect, and update Zendesk tickets.
interface.longDescription: Zendesk Connector provides an OAuth-authenticated local MCP server for Zendesk Support ticket workflows. Use Codex to search tickets, read details, add comments, create tickets, and update common ticket fields.
defaultPrompt: Add an internal note to a Zendesk ticket.
